يصطحبا (form VIII)

# يُصْطَحَبَا (yuṣṭaḥabā) /jusˤ.tˤa.ħa.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
